question: Does applying compressed memory abstractions across functionally disparate domains measurably increase the solution path diversity (L) without degrading goal-directedness (G_A)?
hypothesis: Transferring compressed memory abstractions to a novel functional domain will increase solution path diversity (L) while maintaining positive causal goal-directedness (G_A), provided that the structural invariants of the source domain overlap with the target domain.
next_action: Execute the cross-domain memory transfer experiment to evaluate abstraction utility beyond the originating domain.
